content:
Samir (Support): quick heads-up — AcuHealth trial acct is showing a sharp activation drop this morning, moving to P1. escalating to CS for owner + comms plan.
Mira (CS): ack @Samir (Support) — I'm taking ownership. can you paste the last 24h signal and top error?
Samir (Support): summary: signups ok, but 60% fail at onboarding webhook step. spike started ~08:15 UTC. error 502 from our proxy to customer webhook. sample logs:
```
[2026-03-21T08:18:12Z] POST /v1/callback 502 AcuHealth callback timeout (upstream reset)
[2026-03-21T08:19:03Z] RETRY attempt=2 status=502
```
Lena (Support): also seeing many CSAT messages saying onboarding email not delivered. delivery rates dropped ~55%. linking ticket #S-4382.
Mira (CS): thanks. immediate plan: 1) I will call the customer (AcuHealth PM) at 09:00 UTC to acknowledge and set expectations. 2) send interim comms template (see below). 3) coordinate with eng infra if proxy 502 persists.
Jamie (CSM): I can join the 09:00 call and own the renewal impact notes. Renewal in 6 weeks — we should flag risk and prep mitigations.
Samir (Support): Ops Bot flagged infra deploy at 08:10 UTC to edge-proxy cluster — could be related. ops-bot log: `deploy edge-proxy v2.14 -> rollout completed 08:12`
Mira (CS): ok pinging @eng-infra oncall now. if they confirm rollback window, we'll propose rollback+retry plan to customer.
Samir (Support): ETA from infra?
Ops Bot: @eng-infra oncall paged (page id #34801). current estimated response < 20m.
Mira (CS): comms template (short):
"Hi <AcuHealth PM>,
We’re aware of an onboarding disruption impacting new user activations since ~08:15 UTC. Our team is investigating root cause and will provide updates at 09:00 and 09:30 UTC. We’re treating this as high priority — we’ll share a remediation ETA shortly. Apologies for the disruption. — Mira, Redwood CS"
Jamie (CSM): add: "We're evaluating any potential data loss and will share a compensation proposal if needed."
Samir (Support): operational notes for handoff:
- Ticket: S-4382
- Prod region: us-west-2
- Affected endpoints: POST /v1/callback, /v1/email/send
- Recent infra action: edge-proxy v2.14 rollout @08:10 UTC
- Workaround attempted: client-side retry enabled; partial success on retry.
Mira (CS): next steps timeline:
- 08:44 UTC: eng-infra acked (see thread)
- 08:55 UTC: internal triage call (mira,jamie,samir,lena)
- 09:00 UTC: customer call (mira + jamie)
- 09:15 UTC: proposed fix (rollback or patch) OR ETA update to customer
Lena (Support): sharing customer-owned logs + last webhook request body in ticket now.
Mira (CS): assigning owner: @Mira (CS). handoff checklist: 1) confirm root cause with infra, 2) customer comms at 09:00, 3) open renewal-risk brief for AE (jamie) post-call, 4) capture feedback loop and follow-up survey if disruption >24h.
Jamie (CSM): I’ll prepare the renewal risk note and outreach plan for AE; will attach to the ticket after the call.
Samir (Support): any objections to marking this as "Priority - CS escalation" and routing to the customer success escalation queue?
Mira (CS): no objections. doing it now. tagging #cs-escalations and #eng-infra.
Ops Bot: message posted to #cs-escalations by Mira (CS) at 08:46 UTC
Mira (CS): once we finish the call I’ll post a one-paragraph summary here and the proposed compensation language (if needed).
Samir (Support): thanks team. will update thread with any new error spikes.
Jamie (CSM): +1. prepping notes. see you on the 09:00 call. :phone:
